slides.sub: Rahway, in Union County, has 2 train lines to New York Penn. Here are 4 numbers I'd check first.
slides.source: NJ Division of Taxation; NJ Transit (Oct. 2026)

slides.label: Average 2025 tax bill
slides.body: Rahway's 2025 average residential tax bill. That's about $2,100 under the Union County average ($12,536) and close to the NJ average ($10,340).
slides.source: NJ Division of Taxation, 2025 Average Residential Tax Statistics

slides.label: Median sale price
slides.body: Rahway's median sale price in August 2026, per Redfin. That's up 7.1% from a year earlier. Homes sold in a median of 32 days.

slides.title: 2 train lines to New York Penn
slides.body: Rahway station is on NJ Transit's Northeast Corridor and North Jersey Coast lines. Service is reduced through Nov. 14 for Portal Bridge work, so check your schedule.
slides.source: NJ Transit, Rahway Station; Portal Cutover (Oct. 2026)

slides.title: Up to $15,000 in down payment help
slides.body: NJHMFA offers eligible first-time buyers up to $15,000 in Union County: no interest, no monthly payments, forgiven after 5 years in the home. Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.
slides.source: NJHMFA, First-Time Homebuyer fact sheet (updated June 2026)

caption:
This might trigger you, but not every NJ train town has a sky-high tax bill. Rahway's 2025 average residential tax bill was $10,435. That's about $2,100 under the Union County average and close to the NJ average of $10,340.

Rahway's median sale price was $562,128 in August 2026 (Redfin). The station is on 2 NJ Transit lines to New York Penn. And NJHMFA offers eligible first-time buyers up to $15,000 in down payment help in Union County.

Talk to a licensed lender for your numbers.
